'''Ubrikkian Transports''', also known as '''Ubrikkian Speeders''', was a major manufacturer of [[Repulsorcraft/Legends|repulsorcraft]], including [[Sail barge/Legends|sail barges]], [[Landspeeder/Legends|landspeeders]],<ref name="NEGWT" /> [[Swoop/Legends|swoops]],<ref name="HSCS" /> and [[Hovervan/Legends|hovervans]].<ref name="J3">{{JournalCite|3|Galaxywide NewsNets}}</ref> The company used its military expertise to develop the [[HAVr A9 Floating Fortress/Legends|HAVr A9 Floating Fortress]], a [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsorlift]] weapons platform. Commercially, Ubrikkian manufactured repulsorlift equipment for use in industrial and [[Mining/Legends|mining]] operations, and moved into security and personal defense.<ref name="NEGWT" /> Ubrikkian was a [[contributing sponsor]] of the [[Corporate Sector Authority/Legends|Corporate Sector Authority]].<ref name="HSCS">''[[Han Solo and the Corporate Sector Sourcebook]]''</ref>

Because of their success with the floating fortress, Ubrikkian Transports were awarded the contract in designing the chassis for the [[Imperial-class repulsortank|''Imperial''-class repulsortank]]. The results were the [[Imperial Repulsortank 1-L|1-L]], [[Imperial Repulsortank 1-M|1-M]], and [[Imperial-class 1-H repulsortank/Legends|1-H]] models.<ref name="J9" />
